Dear {{ doc.employee_name or "" }},

We are delighted to offer you the position of “{{ doc.designation or "" }}” in M/s Alantech Industries India Private Limited. effective from {{ doj }}.

Enclosed are your terms and benefits pertaining to the offer.

Each page of the job offer must be initialled and the declaration signed. You must retain one copy of the offer for your reference and one copy is to be returned to the Company for records.

Should you decline this offer or we do not hear from you within 3 working days from the date of this letter, this offer shall automatically be considered “withdrawn / null and void”.

Wish you the very best in your tenure at Alantech Industries India Private Limited

Sincerely

{{ co.custom_hr_signatory_name or "" }}
Alantech Industries India Private Limited

{% if letter_head and not no_letterhead %}
{{ letter_head }}
{% endif %} {% set co = frappe.get_doc("Company", doc.company) %} {% set fmt = "dd MMMM yyyy" %} {% set doj = frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.date_of_joining, fmt) if doc.date_of_joining else "" %} {% set dob = frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.date_of_birth, fmt) if doc.date_of_birth else "" %}
{{ doc.custom_ref_no or "" }} {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(frappe.utils.today(), fmt) }}

LETTER OF EMPLOYMENT

{{ doc.employee_name or "" }}
{{ doc.current_address or doc.permanent_address or "" }}

Contact No: {{ doc.cell_number or "" }}

Dear {{ doc.employee_name or "" }},

We are pleased to appoint you on the following terms & conditions.

1. The Job

1.1 Employee Code: {{ doc.name }}
1.2 Position: {{ doc.designation or "" }}
1.3 Department: {{ doc.department or "" }}
1.4 Location of Employment: {{ doc.branch or "" }}
1.5 Date of Joining: {{ doj }}
1.6 CTC: {% if doc.ctc %}INR {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.ctc) }}{% endif %}
1.7 Probation: You will be on probation for a period of six months from the date of your joining. Your services during probation can be terminated by 30 days’ notice on either side.

2. Leave

You will be entitled for leave in a financial year as per the leave policy of the company.

3. Hours Of Work

Alantech Industries India Private Limited operates on a 08-hour minimum working/day. However, employees are expected to work the hours reasonably required to complete the task they have been assigned and/or to suit the local business practice. The whole company works on a team approach and the employee’s hours may vary according to the volume of work on hand and out of hours work may be required.

4. Transfer

The company may utilize your services in any section/division, office or establishment and/or related companies forming a part of Alantech Industries India Private Limited, in any part of India without any additional remuneration or compensation. On transfer to the new location, you will be bound by the working rules, regulations, timings, leave entitlement, weekly off days, paid holidays etc. applicable at that location.

5. Other Matters

a) You will not without prior written permission from the company carry on any business or profession or any part-time assignment or publish any article or deliver any talk on any subject related to the activities you are either directly or indirectly engaged in for the company.

b) You will devote your entire attention to your duties to promote the interest of the company.

c) You will be responsible for all company assets in your custody. The company reserves the right to deduct the money value of such things from your dues and take such other action as deemed proper in the event of your failure to account for such property to its satisfaction.

d) You shall inform the company about any new or novel process, techniques or design you may make, discover or invent. All such discoveries or inventions will be the property of the company. The company may at its discretion take patents in your name for such discoveries or inventions & the company will retain the rights to such address.

6. Secrecy

You, during your employment and thereafter for period of three years from the date of separation for any reason whatsoever, shall not divulge or disclose to anyone any confidential or business information related to the company (including group companies) or its affairs, products, processes etc.

7. Work Ethics

In keeping with the “Code of Conduct” policy of the company of conducting its affairs in strict compliance in letter and spirit of the law and adherence to business ethics, you shall not:

a) Accept or offer substantial gifts, or indulge in entertainment, favors or payments which can be construed as excessive, influencing or improper.

b) Borrow from or lend to or avail services of employees, customers or suppliers.

c) Misuse or allow to be misused the property of the company.

d) Initiate or approve any form of personal, sexual or social harassment or discrimination of anyone.

8. Separation

a) If for any reason you wish to resign from the company’s services, you may do so by giving 30 days’ notice in writing or pay the company 30 days basic salary in lieu thereof. Similarly, the company can at its discretion terminate your services by giving 30 days’ notice in writing or pay 30 days basic salary.

b) This contract of employment may be terminated without notice or any compensation in lieu thereof, if any act of yours is detrimental to the interest of the company, or contravenes any conditions of this appointment or if any information provided by you during the process of appointment is found to be incorrect or false.

c) At the time of separation your full and final will be done subject to clearances as per no dues form, handing over form as well as from all the requisite customers.

9. Policies, Rules and Regulations

Any change in the rules and regulations, policies, and guidelines announced by the company from time to time and applicable to you will form a part of this employment.

10. Retirement:

We have recorded your date of birth {{ dob }} based on the data given by you. You will retire on reaching an age of 58 (fifty-eight) years.

11. Training abroad:

During your service with the company, if you are sent for training at company’s expense, you will be liable to serve the company for 3 (three) years from the date of your training. In case you decide to leave the company before period of three years, you shall be liable to repay the total cost incurred by the company for such training.

12. E-mail:

E-mail facility provided by the company is to be used exclusively for company’s business. The company will have the right to check the e-mails sent and received. Sending any information related to the company to unauthorized persons will be treated as a breach of trust and will be construed as a serious offence. You will be personally responsible for the misuse of the e-mail and all its consequences including litigation arising there from.

We welcome you as a member of Alantech Industries India Private Limited and hope that our association will be mutually rewarding.

Regards,


{{ co.custom_hr_signatory_name or "" }}
HR Manager
Alantech Industries India Private Limited
